description: Search one named shelf of the classical Islamic library (8,594 works) for quotable passages: verbatim Arabic with book, author, printed volume/page, edition and a shamela.ws link. The default first search for hadith, tafsir, fiqh or creed. Not for isnads, narrators or diacritic-exact wording. Use shamela_search (match "words") to pin books or categories or to page past 10 results, shamela_read (unit "page") to read a whole page. Scope is one shelf per call; call again with another shelf to widen. Ranking: exact phrase first, then all the words; a madhhab scope asks that school's own books first; main text before footnote. relaxedToTokens and note flag a weaker match; no passages means absent from that scope, not from the library. A non-Arabic query or unknown scope returns a tool error naming the fix.

query.description: Arabic search text. A quoted wording works best; a topic also works.

scope.description: hadith-primary — The eight primary hadith collections, edition-pinned; tafsir-canonical — Canonical tafsir — Ibn Kathir, al-Tabari, Ibn al-Jawzi first; fiqh-hanafi — Hanafi fiqh (+ usul, comparative); fiqh-maliki — Maliki fiqh (+ usul, comparative); fiqh-shafii — Shafi'i fiqh (+ usul, comparative); fiqh-hanbali — Hanbali fiqh (+ usul, comparative); fiqh-comparative — All four schools plus comparative and fatwa collections; aqeedah — Creed and sects; hadith-sciences — Hadith commentary, takhrij and the sciences of hadith; tafsir — The whole tafsir shelf and Quranic sciences; seerah — Prophetic biography, history and biographical dictionaries; lugha — Arabic language, lexicons, grammar and adab

name: shamela_search_library

booksSearched.description: Books in the searched scope, or null when the library did not say.

note.description: Present only when the result needs a caveat; carry it with the passages.

passages.description: Best evidence first: exact phrase before word matches, main text before footnote, the school's own shelf before the wider one. Empty when nothing in the scope matched.

arabic.description: The passage, verbatim, markup removed; at most 1,600 characters, cut with "…".

authorDied.description: Year of death in AH, or null.

book.description: Title including the printing, e.g. "صحيح البخاري - ط السلطانية".

edition.description: Omitted when the library records none.

editor.description: The muhaqqiq; omitted when the library records none.

matchQuality.description: How the library matched the page, e.g. "exact_phrase".

matchedIn.description: Where the words were found. A footnote match is the editor's text, not the author's.

pageId.description: Shamela's page id; with bookId it addresses the page for shamela_read (unit page).

printedPage.description: Volume and page as that printing paginates it, e.g. "1/ 6"; null when the library has no printed pagination.

publisher.description: Omitted when the library records none.

relaxedToTokens.description: True when the exact phrase was not found and a looser word search answered.

totalMatches.description: Matching pages the library verified in the scope before the limit, or null.

title: Search the classical Islamic library
